### Sing a New Song (Psalm 96:1) - Your Daily Bible Verse - August 7
Author: Brent Rinehart
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-august-7.html
Passage: Psalm 96:1
Points:
- Familiar hymns bring comfort, but Scripture urges believers to sing a new song.
- Singing a new song requires encountering God in a fresh, daily way.
- Ongoing trials and struggles provide opportunities to see God working in new ways.
- Trusting God in difficult circumstances produces maturity that fuels renewed worship.
- We cannot control external events, but we can choose to respond with praise.

### Two Sides of Judgment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/two-sides-judgment
Passage: Psalm 96:10-13
Points:
- God's judgment brings terror to the impenitent but assurance and joy to the faithful.
- Believers clothed in Christ's righteousness will be publicly vindicated on the final day.
- Biblical judgment involves not only a verdict, but the complete renewal of creation.
- Christians can anticipate the Lord's return with gladness as His righteous reign is revealed.
